title: Malformed Id is rejected
why: Checks input validation: a non-uuid Id must fail as a bad request, not as not-found or a server error.

steps.does: Call gRPC PassengerGrpcService/GetById with Id set to the string 'not-a-uuid'.

expect: gRPC INVALID_ARGUMENT status mentioning the invalid Id; no database lookup result and no internal error.
